title.narrative: Provision of protection, social-psychological support, MPCA to children and their parents in Zaporizhhya, Dnipro, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Kharkiv, Sumy regions.

description.narrative: ltpgtProject “Provision of protection, social-psychological support, MPCA to children and their parents in Zaporizhzhya, Dnipro, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Kharkiv, Sumy, regions” will be implemented by Charitable organization “Ukrainian Education Platform” (covers PSS in Mykolaiv, Kherson, Kharkiv, Sumy, and Multi Purpose Cash Assistance in Dnipro, Zaporizhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumy regions)ltbrgttogether with three sub-partners:ltbrgtKharkiv region CO “Myrne nebo Kharkova” (covers Zaporizhzhya, Dnipro, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Kharkiv, Sumy regions with EORE)ltbrgtDnipro region CO “Globa 22” (covers PSS in Dnipro region)ltbrgtZaporizhia region CF “Caritas” (covers PSS in Zaporizhia region)lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project is aiming to cover 5th Multisectorial priority“Provision of education, child protection, GBV (risk mitigation for education institutions), and mine action (EORE) principled and timely life-saving assistance among conflict-affected displaced people, non-displaced people and returnees considering gender, age and inclusivity approaches.” and Single sectoral Priority 2ltbrgt“Provide emergency MPC to conflict-affected vulnerable people to meet their basic needs.ltbrgtMPC will be provided to conflict-affected households and protracted IDPs to cover basic needs and avert falling into negative coping strategies. We will target socioeconomically vulnerable families displaced for more than thirty days and residing in areas where armed conflict has occurred in recent months, using the CWG targeting framework to ensure prioritization of resources.”ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtClusters: ltbrgtCash Working Group (CWG)ltbrgtProtection - Child Protection (CP)ltbrgtProtection - Mine Action (MA)ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtProject is aiming at covering complex needs of children and their families. ltbrgtProject covers 6 regions: Zaporizhhya, Dnipro, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Kharkiv, Sumy.ltbrgtIn each region will be renovated space for provision of protection, social-psychological support to children and their families. Such specialists will be involved: social worker (case management specialist), psychologist, speech therapist.ltbrgtTogether with that, for each region one mobile brigade will be organized to provide the same services in hromadas of that region. ltbrgtCF “Myrne nebo Kharkova”, as a sub-partner who have an accreditation for providing EORE forms 6 mobile teams to cover the same locations as for PSS. ltbrgtMulti Purpose Cash Assistance will be provided in Dnipro, Zaporizhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumska regions and will cover 63% of beneficiaries covered by PSS.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtWithin the project framework will be provided complex assistance: ltbrgtProvide emergency MPC to 2500 conflict-affected children and their families to meet their basic needs Dnipro, Zaporizhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumska regions.ltbrgt5160 children and their parents/guardians, including IDP families, families in difficult life circumstances, family-type children's homes, those living in front-line areas, single mothers, large families and others by providing psycho-social assistance, we will be able to improve the psycho-emotional state of children and their parents, correct speech disorders in children, and provide case management support to families in Dnipro, Zaporizhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumska regions.ltbrgt5,100 children and their parents/guardians will receive basic knowledge about the rules for handling explosive objects and the algorithm of actions when they are found in Dnipro, Zaporizhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Sumska regions.ltbrgtlt/pgt
